summary: Comprehensive language switching testing completed for Roads of Ireland bilingual website (English/Irish). All 13 pages successfully translate between English and Irish when language switcher is clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is correct - each page uses a content object with en/ga keys and useLanguage() hook
Navigation menu translates via t() function from LanguageContext
Footer translates via t() function from translations.js
Language preference persists across page navigation via localStorage
Minor console warning: hydration errors on pages with tables (TollRoads, TrafficRules, SpeedLimits) due to span wrapping tr elements - does not affect functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language switching feature is fully functional. All 13 pages (Home, Motorways, Toll Roads, Traffic Rules, Scenic Routes, Speed Limits, Road Signs, Parking, Petrol Stations, Emergency, Tips, About, Contact) translate correctly between English and Irish. The t() function from translations.js handles navigation and common elements, while individual pages use content objects with en/ga keys.
